metadata.title: On the structure of stable constant anisotropic mean curvature hypersurfaces
metadata.abstract: We prove that a stable noncompact hypersurface with constant anisotropic mean curvature in $\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$ has only one end for $n \le 6$, under a natural ellipticity condition on the anisotropy. This provides an anisotropic counterpart of the one-end theorem for stable constant mean curvature hypersurfaces. We remark that the result is also new in $\mathbb R^7 (n=6)$, in the case of anisotropic minimal hypersurfaces. The proof relies on the existence of a Sobolev-type inequality.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 稳定各向异性超曲面的单端性
analysis.workSummary: 在自然椭圆性条件下，证明 R^(n+1) 中 n≤6 的稳定非紧常各向异性平均曲率超曲面只有一个端。
analysis.breakthrough: 得到各向异性单端定理，并覆盖 R⁷ 中新的各向异性极小情形。
analysis.limitations: 维数上界和各向异性椭圆条件不可省略。
